name: Moth to a Matchstick
source:
Ignite the past, one match at a time, and discover if love can withstand time as fleeting as the matches you light. Can you rekindle a love lost in the shadows before the flame fades away forever?

[From [url=https://try-froggery.itch.io/moth-to-a-matchstick]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一次点燃一根火柴，点燃过去，看看爱情是否能像你点燃的火柴一样经受住转瞬即逝的时间。在火焰永远消失之前，你能重新点燃在阴影中迷失的爱情吗？

[来自[url=https://try-froggery.itch.io/moth-to-a-matchstick]itch.io[/url]]
